'''Chris Mead''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[February 2001 Parker tournament (17 February)]] on 17 February 2001 with [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Profit]], according to Brian Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1901">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-15-2-17-01-fall-of-the-legendd1901/ 2-17-01-fall-of-the-legend], DeckTech (Brian "HuntaWarya" Hunter, 15 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-15-2-17-01-fall-of-the-legendd1901/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
